the headline answer is E101154-scoped while the plan goal names 'an OP1 equilibrium'; the reachable on-disk EQDSK for shot 101011 (inside the plan's OP1 range 100001..101173) does carry psi grid + q profile, so the answer should stay qualified to E101154.

justifications.durability: The record is a static HTML fragment whose every factual claim is recoverable from the committed fragment text and the run's probe logs, so a reader can re-check the E101154 IRET 300 reproduction and the reader positive control without the live host. The node's dispatch states this node's write paths reach no test path and no red log is required, so this is a record defect rather than a promotion refusal, but the missing reproduction pointer weakens the durable record.
justifications.evidence: Every route claim traces to a probe log with the exact call and its return, all present under the run's probe/ directory: 12-eqdb-read.log records GetTimeList(0,101154)->105 slices and GetEqData(0,101154,500)->IRET=300 with GetEqItem(PSI) shape (0,); 13-eddb-fame.log records eddbreadCatTable desclist entry 'Fast Analyzer for Magnetohydrodynamic Equilibrium (FAM...' and FAME count/read; 22-selene-route.log records the RUN EFIT95 header shot 63632; 18-eqdsk-route.log records the positive control (fbequ EFIT95 shot 101011, psi (129,129), q (129,), Ip 0.4927 MA, qmax 42.62) and the absent 101154, and 23-psrc-read.log records PSRC count 303 and the three named channel shapes. A positive control on the reader is included, so the empty E101154 result is shown to be an absence. Deductions: fragment Route 1 states the 105 slices span '500 .. 11500 ms', but no probe log records the upper bound (the logs record only '105 slices'); and the manifest's negative_control_log references a file that does not exist.

justifications.goal_fidelity: The fragment answers the plan's §6 node question honestly: it enumerates every candidate route found read-only on nakasvr26 beginning in /home/d240034 (FAME EQDB eqdb=0, EDDB FAME scalar bank, SELENE efitout.f / RUN EFIT95.DATA, FBEQU outputs, LOCALDB EQDSK, EDDB PSRC, and the hosts/mounts/socket endpoints the code names), gives one E101154 slice read per route, quotes the site's own expansion of FAME, and names the best route. Deduction: the headline answer scopes to E101154 while the plan goal named "an OP1 equilibrium", and the reachable on-disk EQDSK for shot 101011 (inside the plan's own OP1 pulse range 100001..101173) does carry psi grid + q profile — surfaced in Route 4 and best-route (3), but the headline 'none reaches a psi grid and q profile' reads broader than the E101154-scoped evidence.
justifications.reuse: The node builds on the existing readers and on its predecessor fragments rather than re-deriving them: it reuses the EQDB reader's own schema (FleddTool, eqdbget.f) and the local EQDSK parser (prova/eqdsk.py), and it corroborates Route 6 against jtmm-psrc-selene-inventory's PSRC finding (none of the 303 names 86 examined there is a q profile or flux grid) rather than repeating the scan. Deduction: it restates the PSRC inventory conclusion at length where a reference would have sufficed.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --stat d442dbe9..8b5728f2 and git show --stat 8b5728f2 list exactly one changed file, docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-machine-map/jtmm-equilibrium-route-search.html (230 insertions), which is the manifest's declared changed_path and within the node's declared write scope; no product source and no test is touched, matching the plan's 'one fragment and no source'. git merge-base --is-ancestor confirms 8b5728f2 is the reviewed head on the node branch, not an ancestor of this worktree's HEAD.
